scope: Dashboard UI only; no CFD controllers, plans, solvers or field renderer modified.
acceptance_filter: Fields require finite unchanged accepted configured result, matching saved time/source directory/order/dt/inner and manifest output.
visual_review: Desktop figures have readable axes and captions without overlap. Mobile deliberately pans each figure horizontally; captions wrap inside viewport and enlargement works. Separate historical and configured cohorts remain explicit.

print.status: No clipping, split figures or orphaned fragments. Each configured field occupies its own intentional page.

wave_panel.classification: Propagation identified by status, scope or case, preserving correct wording during needs_review.
wave_panel.validation: No propagation or foil-force validation claimed; next gate remains wave gauges/time resolution.
